scientific_intent.scientific_task: Count samples whose true class is in the top5 scores under a deterministic tie rule.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Rank=true-score exceedance count plus equal-score class indices<=label; count rows with rank<=5.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 4096 independent128-class score rows and one label per row; scalar Int32 count.
invariants: Tie-breaking includes the label itself and prefers smaller class indices.
accuracy_requirements: Exact finite Int32 count, full CPU/dual-reference check; repeated operation resets counter inside timed operation.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 comparisons determine ranks; count and atomics are Int32, not floating-point accumulation.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: N4096,D128,top5,grid1024,256threads,four rows per block,ten repeats; optimizednativekernel2 unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Classification evaluation primitive; no source-evidenced model, dataset or scientific prediction task.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Measured scalar is a correct-label count, not a normalized accuracy fraction; comparisons are not conventional FLOP work.
